selection.molecules: First nine distinct molecular formulae in ascending sample-ID order with connected, sanitizable neutral RDKit graphs inferred from the saved coordinates (RDKit 2026.03.6); no coordinate optimization. This is an illustration filter, not the benchmark validity calculation.
selection.materials: First nine distinct unit-cell compositions in saved LeMat-GenBench valid_structure_ids order; staged decompressed bytes verified equal to original sample. No stability/novelty filtering or relaxation.
selection.proteins: First lexicographic designable sample nearest each target length 60, 90, 120 within each category: helix-rich (alpha >=0.6, beta <0.1), mixed (alpha >=0.2, beta >=0.2), sheet-rich (beta >=0.4, alpha <0.1). Fractions and best-of-eight CA scRMSD <1.5 Angstrom from saved evaluation; not recomputed. Rendered PDBs are generated backbones, not refolds.
selection.omol25: Stratified by conditioning-source OMol25 data_id: first source filename and largest saved output by atom count for biomolecules (filename order breaks size ties), first two source filenames for elytes, first eligible filename for the other eight subsets. Connectivity eligibility is defined in omol25_connectivity_filter. Twelve outputs cover all ten subsets; no sanitization, formula uniqueness, stability or transition-state filter. Generated coordinates and atom identities unchanged. Labels describe source provenance, not classification.
selection.omat24: First nine distinct generated unit-cell compositions with at most 40 atoms in ascending source filename order (size restriction for visual legibility). Finite lattice parameters and positive saved volume checked; no validity, stability, uniqueness, or novelty filtering. No coordinate optimization or relaxation.

omol25_omat24_run.sampling: Saved force-conditioned generation validation predictions; no inference or relaxation rerun.

omol25_subset_provenance.join: source_row_index in generation_input.extra, indexed into ASELMDBDataset over lexicographically sorted *.aselmdb shards, excluding ._* files. Source metadata: extra_info.data_id and extra_info.source.
omol25_subset_provenance.verification: For all 1,000 source records, reference atom count, charge, and spin equal generation input values, and recomputed mean atomic force norm matches input value within absolute tolerance 1e-10 eV/angstrom.
omol25_subset_provenance.category_interpretation: Atom count, charge, spin and mean atomic force norm are supplied to generation; source category and reference composition/coordinates are not fixed. Transition-1x and RGD1 contain reaction-path geometries; generated outputs are not validated transition states.

omol25_connectivity_filter.method: DetermineConnectivity(useHueckel=False, useVdw=True, covFactor=1.3); GetMolFrags; all atoms including hydrogens. No bond-order assignment, sanitization, fragment removal, or coordinate optimization.
omol25_connectivity_filter.policy: Require one generated component for GEOM. For ANI-2x, OrbNet Denali and SPICE require one component when the reference graph is connected. Other subsets remain unfiltered to allow complexes, clusters and reactions.

omol25_biomolecule_size_selection.rule: Largest generated atom count (including hydrogens) among the 210 biomolecule-source outputs in the existing 1,000-output epoch_75 OMol25 cohort; ascending source filename breaks ties. No new inference, connectivity filtering, fragment removal or optimization.
omol25_biomolecule_size_selection.verification: All 210 saved biomolecule outputs parsed with finite coordinates and atom counts matching their generation input and source reference. Source charge, spin and mean atomic force norm checked against generation input; absolute force-norm tolerance 1e-10 eV/angstrom.
